title: Launch Pre-Order Privileges of Marlowe Rewards Members
content:
Marlowe Rewards tiers carry three privileges for Launch Pre-Orders under Pre-Orders & Back-Orders: early access before public opening, an allocation priority when launch stock is short, and a limit on open units of one style.

| Tier | Hours before public opening the tier may place a Launch Pre-Order | Allocation priority when launch stock is short (1 is served first) | Most open Launch Pre-Order units of one style per member |
|---|---|---|---|
| Marlowe Rewards Member | 0 | 6 | 1 |
| Marlowe Rewards Silver | 0 | 5 | 1 |
| Marlowe Rewards Gold | 0 | 4 | 1 |
| Marlowe Rewards Platinum | 24 | 3 | 1 |
| Marlowe Rewards Icon | 48 | 2 | 2 |
| Marlowe Rewards Atelier | 72 | 1 | 2 |

## Points of judgement

- Early access of 0 hours means the tier may place a Launch Pre-Order only once public opening begins.
- A lower priority number is served first. When launch stock is short, Atelier (1) is served before Icon (2), and Marlowe Rewards Member (6) is served last.
- Icon and Atelier members may hold up to 2 open units of one style. Every other tier may hold 1.
